description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per funding check - the payment buys one signed funding-and-gas readiness check of the wallet address and challenge you submit: a READY / NOT-READY verdict with every missing item named (asset balance and fee coverage), read live at check time. The queried wallet is never stored.

challenge.description: The payment challenge to check readiness against: network (solana or base), scheme, asset (mint or contract), amount_required (atomic units, string), facilitator when the client mode is facilitator.

wallet_address.description: The wallet whose readiness is checked (a Solana pubkey for network solana, an EVM address for network base). Never stored.

name: funding_check_check
